newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Turnbull named to Swire Pacific board.
newsitem.headline: Turnbull named to Swire Pacific board.

text.p: David Turnbull, incoming managing director of Cathay Pacific Ltd, will join the board of Swire Pacific Ltd effective November 1, Swire said on Thursday.
Turnbull, also chairman of Hong Kong Aircraft Engineering Co Ltd, will assume executive responsibility of Swire's Aviation division on December 1 when he becomes Cathay's managing director.

Swire also said outgoing Cathay managing director Rod Eddington has tendered his resignation from the Swire board effective December 31. Eddington was appointed executive chairman of Ansett Australia in late September.
Swire Pacific holds 43.9 percent of Cathay Pacific.
